# First, find the date of the match in Atlanta, Georgia
atlanta_match = df[df['Championship'].str.contains('Atlanta, Georgia', case=False, na=False)]
if not atlanta_match.empty:
    atlanta_date = atlanta_match['Date'].iloc[0]
    # Extract month from the date string (assuming format "Month Day, Year")
    atlanta_month = atlanta_date.split()[0]  # Gets the month name
    # Filter df for other matches in the same month (excluding the Atlanta match itself)
    same_month_matches = df[df['Date'].str.startswith(atlanta_month) & (df['Championship'] != atlanta_match['Championship'].iloc[0])]
    if not same_month_matches.empty:
        # Select one match (e.g., the first one) and get its championship name
        answer = same_month_matches['Championship'].iloc[0]
    else:
        answer = None
else:
    answer = None
